remarks: Welcome to Adams Mill River House!  This beautifully renovated condo offers the ease of single-level living with 2 spacious bedrooms, 2 full bathrooms, and multiple walk-in closets for ample storage. The immaculate kitchen shines with stainless steel appliances and an island, which has a beautiful open floor plan into the living space for assured comfort year-round and hot water heater (2023). Enjoy the convenience of an in-unit washer & dryer and relax on the rear-facing private balcony overlooking the stunning courtyard and downtown Stamford.   Residents can take advantage of top-tier amenities including a fully equipped fitness center, private garden area with a gazebo, picnic tables, and BBQ grills - perfect for year-round enjoyment. This pet-friendly, elevator building features a gated private parking garage with 2 reserved spots, ample guest parking, and freshly painted common areas.  Ideally located just steps from shopping, dining, schools, beaches, golf courses, and medical centers. Explore Mill River Park just around the corner - with food trucks, festivals, concerts, outdoor movies, a carousel, ice-skating rink, and scenic walking trails.  Commuters will love the proximity (9 minute walk) to Metro North and Amtrak stations, plus quick access to I-95.  Don't miss this rare opportunity to own a move-in ready condo in one of the area's most desirable communities!
